about: The shared game soundtrack: one entry per track. npm run music:soundtrack generates takes for each (seeds), judges them, loops and masters the best into public/audio/bgm/ and writes manifest.json. 'pick' pins a seed once a take has been chosen. Styles only: never name a composer, artist or game.
